$clearCache.description: Clears cached data, clearing all tables if no table is provided

$deleteCache.description: Deletes data from the cache by variable

$exportCache.description: Exports all entries from a cache table to a JSON file

$getCache.description: Retrieves and loads data from the cache by variable

$hasCache.description: Checks if a cache key exists

$importCache.description: Imports entries from a JSON file into a cache table

$keysCache.description: Returns all keys from the cache joined by a separator

$rangeCache.description: Retrieves all entries from the cache

$setCache.description: Sets a cache variable to the specified value

$jsonDivide.description: Divides a JSON key by a number

keys;value.description: Keys to traverse, last element is the target value

$jsonMulti.description: Multiplies a JSON key by a number

keys;value.description: Keys to traverse, last element is the target value

$jsonSub.description: Subtracts a number from a JSON key

keys;value.description: Keys to traverse, last element is the target value

$jsonSum.description: Adds a number to a JSON key

keys;value.description: Keys to traverse, last element is the target value

$qev.description: Retrieves an environment value with fallback to structure defaults

$clamp.description: Clamps the value to the specified range

$factorial.description: Calculates the factorial of a number

$gcd.description: Calculates the greatest common divisor of two numbers

$lcm.description: Calculates the least common multiple of two numbers

$benchmark.description: Runs a code block N times and returns elapsed time and ops/sec

iterations.description: How many times to run the code, defaults to 1

variable.description: Environment variable to load the result into

$call.description: Calls a local JS function defined in the command file

args.description: Arguments to pass to the function

$parallel.description: Runs multiple code blocks in parallel and returns all results as an array

code.description: Code block to run in parallel

$processEnv.description: Gets the Node.js environment variable value

$requireCache.description: Deletes a module from the cache or reloads it (including dependencies)

$spread.description: Spreads a delimited string as individual rest arguments

$updateStructures.description: Reloads all default value schemas from the previously loaded folder
